endpoint: Ordinary answer accuracy; unparseable responses count as errors. No balanced accuracy is computed or reported.
comparisons: Eight KG configurations x seven answerers x two stages x four depths versus each of BM25 and Qwen dense; 448 per comparator and 896 per dataset. No maximum over stages in paired inference.

bootstrap.weighting: Question-weighted mean; denominator recomputed each draw

paired_test.unit: one shared random sign per cluster

multiplicity.primary: Holm over 896 contrasts jointly across BM25 and Qwen dense, separately per dataset
multiplicity.secondary: Holm over 448 contrasts within each comparator for reconciliation with the preserved original analysis
multiplicity.expansion: Existing separate two-contrast query-expansion family unchanged

limitations: Conditional on saved generations; no model-run or annotation uncertainty.
Independent clusters and exchangeable signs are assumptions.
This compares full retrieval configurations, not an isolated graph-topology intervention.
